candidate.description: One local256 projection/head/KV workgroup owns four adjacent Q/K/V/gate columns, reuses each BF16 activation across four FP16 weight rows, and preserves four independent F32 accumulation and reduction trees.

correctness.red: The focused tile4 global fixture failed because the Python/C ABI did not exist.
correctness.green_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 PYTHONPATH=. pytest -q tests/test_laguna_head_kv_fusion.py -k 'f16_projection_head_kv_is_bit_exact and tile4' --maxfail=1
correctness.coverage: Global and SWA fixtures matched every projection F32 bit, normalized Q/K F32 bit, active KV BF16 bit, KVLiveSpans field, and self-resetting completion counter.

screen.protocol: one same-resident counterbalanced p512/d128 directional pair; load excluded
screen.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compare-f16-projection-tile4 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-f16-projection-tile4-screen.json

decision.reason: The complete resident screen is decisively negative. The extra live accumulators and reduction state cost more than the additional activation reuse saves.
